event.event_name: Mediterranean heatwave wildfire smoke and dust episode

provenance.notes: Core scoring uses report text, ERA5-Land gridded aggregate statistics, Sentinel-2 dNBR, and AlphaEarth annual change. Off-event point weather fills and EONET catalog counts are not used in the diagnosis.

criteria.name: Requested JSON schema
criteria.description: Returns all seven requested ledger fields with no unrelated action or briefing content.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete JSON ledger with one missing or renamed field.

criteria.name: Report component extraction
criteria.description: Finds all three report-confirmed components and the two pollutant components from the Copernicus report text.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if one component or pollutant flag is missed.

criteria.name: ERA5 gridded heat and stagnation screen
criteria.description: Computes gridded heat score 3, mean wind speed near 2.45 m/s, maximum wind-vector screen near 3.471 m/s, precipitation mean near 15.640 mm, and stagnation proxy score 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct heat score, wind vector calculation, precipitation screen, or stagnation score.

criteria.name: Surface fire signal
criteria.description: Uses dNBR and AlphaEarth metrics to compute surface_fire_signal_score 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct use of only one surface-change family.

criteria.name: Load index and diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct direction with one arithmetic or threshold error.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the explanation tied to report, gridded weather, and surface-change evidence without using off-event point weather, EONET fire catalogs, or health-outcome overclaims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if one unsupported evidence family is mentioned but does not alter the final label.
